items.label: Practical Lift-top Design
items.value: This coffee table is equipped with a spring lift mechanism that helps bring the tabletop to you and creates an 47.5 x 23.5 inches (L×W) spacious working/dining surface while you relaxing on the sofa. The metal mechanism raises the tabletop from 19.5 to 25 inches easily and smoothly

items.label: Functional and Versatile
items.value: Sporting a neutral coloring and clean lines, this lift-top table is the piece that can blend harmoniously with most home styles. With this functional living room furniture, you don’t need to bend over to work or dine on the table while relaxing on the couch

items.label: Basic Living Room Table
items.value: The clean lines and neutral solid hues complete the modern look of this lift-top coffee table. It can blend with your living room ensembles in most styles and designs

items.label: Hidden and Open Storage Space
items.value: A storage compartment hidden under the top keeps your everyday items like laptop, game controllers and suchlike right at hand yet out-of-sight when not in use

items.label: Adjustable Bottom Shelf Height
items.value: There are two ground clearance of this coffee table, 3.5 and 4.7 inches, for accommodating items of different sizes. The flexible design also makes robot vacuum cleaners easy to slip under the table if needed
